title: Registry: scale-out N/A (fixed 2+2 HA per ADR-0036; actionable)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add registry --role harbor --yes`. The registry HA shape is FIXED by ADR-0036: a 2-node Harbor app pair behind round-robin DNS + a 2-node PostgreSQL/Redis datastore pair behind a VRRP VIP. Capacity scales by image-layer storage in MinIO (grow the lakehouse EC pool) and by vertical resize, not by adding registry nodes. The verb refuses with an actionable message naming the terraform path, never a silent no-op.

observe.what: an actionable N/A: the 2+2 HA is the ADR-0036 standard; growth is image-layer storage in MinIO + vertical scale-up, or a terraform op

whatProves: RegistryAdapter graceful-N/As scale-out add/remove with an actionable message (the 2+2 RR-DNS/VRRP HA is fixed IaC), never a silent skip.
